verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a subscription monetization platform, so usage-based and hybrid pricing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers only products, entitlements, offerings, packages, intro offers and paywalls. Nothing documents tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit or usage-plus-subscription pricing, nor credits, commitments or overage billing.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code
